title: Define and export the routing metrics: mistakes caught in the least-confident N percent, and promised-versus-actual at a threshold
description: Add two recorded metrics per window to the exporter: (a) for N in 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 percent, the share of that window's mistakes that fall in the least-confident N percent; (b) for thresholds 0.75 to 0.95 in steps of 0.05, how many items are auto-approved, their mean stated confidence (promised), their actual accuracy (got), and whole-system accuracy with reviewed items counted as right. Compute for both the decision model's raw confidence and the cyclotron's. These are the numbers the marketing site's rule pictogram uses; today the site computes them itself from cycles. Acceptance: the fixture carries them; the site reads them instead of recomputing; specs pin the 400-cycle values (before 100 approved, 52 right; after 74 approved, 63 right at 0.80).
